dataset: Pipe and tube dimensions for insulation estimating (steel pipe OD, copper tube OD, ASTM C585 insulation dimensions, manufacturer actuals)

conventions.unverified: The literal string 'unverified' means no published source was found for that value. Nothing has been guessed, averaged or computed to fill a gap.
conventions.src: Each row's 'src' lists ids in this file's 'sources' array.
conventions.decimal_conversion: Sproule (D6) prints fractions; 'insulation_od_in' is the exact decimal of the printed fraction (e.g. 2 7/8 = 2.875). The fraction as printed is kept alongside it.

steel_pipe_od.standard: ASME B36.10M (the request said ANSI B36.10; B36.10 is now published by ASME as B36.10M). OD is fixed per NPS regardless of schedule.
notes: For NPS 14 and larger, OD equals the NPS number.
Wheatland's table (D1) stops at NPS 18; NPS 20–24 rest on D2, D3 and D4, which agree.
Only standard B36.10M sizes from 1/2 to 24 are listed here; odd sizes used for insulation nesting (4-1/2, 7, 9, 11) appear in the C585 table below with their source.
discrepancies: None: every listed source gives the same OD for every NPS.

copper_tube_od.standard: ASTM B88 seamless copper water tube (Types K, L, M share the same OD); values from CDA Copper Tube Handbook Table 14.2b
notes: Actual OD is 1/8 in. larger than the nominal size for every size listed (CDA Table 14.2b values).
Insulation for copper is ordered by tube OD ('copper tube size', CTS).

rows.note: Nominal 5/8 (0.750 OD) is an ASTM B88 size but does not appear in the C585 tube tables or the insulation makers' copper tables reviewed here.

astm_c585.title: Standard Practice for Inner and Outer Diameters of Thermal Insulation for Nominal Sizes of Pipe and Tubing
astm_c585.scope_summary: Dimensional standard for preformed pipe and tubing insulation supplied in cylindrical sections. It lists recommended single-layer inner and outer diameters for nominal wall thicknesses from 1/2 to 5 in. (13 to 127 mm). Inch-pound values are the standard.
astm_c585.access_note: The C585 tables are paywalled. Per the request, only values reproduced in published manufacturer or fabricator documents are included. Unauthorized copies of the standard found online were not used.

insulation_inner_diameter.reason: No manufacturer or fabricator reproduction of the C585 inner-diameter table (Table 1) with plausible values was found. The only one found (Sproule, D6 page 2) is internally inconsistent and was rejected (details below).

why_rejected: NPS 1/2 is printed as 13/16 in. (0.8125), which is smaller than the 0.840 in. pipe OD, so it cannot be an insulation bore.
NPS 5 is printed as 5 and NPS 6 as 5 9/16, which looks like a one-row shift (5.563 is the NPS 5 pipe OD).
The NPS rows otherwise just track nominal pipe OD fractions (for example 1 7/8 for NPS 1-1/2, whose OD is 1.900), with no bore clearance.
The tube rows equal the tube OD exactly (for example 5/8 for 1/2 nominal), again with no clearance.

insulation_inner_diameter.product_specific_alternative: JM's Micro-Lok HP sheet (D8) prints a column labeled 'Pipe O.D.' whose values (for example 0.90 for NPS 1/2) exceed the B36.10M pipe OD. They equal the insulation OD minus twice the actual wall within 0.03 in. on every row, so they appear to be that product's bore. They are listed under manufacturer_product_actuals, not as C585 values.

actual_thickness.reason: Neither C585-labeled source found (D6, D7) prints actual (as-fabricated) wall thickness. Product actual walls from JM (D8) and Knauf (D4) are listed under manufacturer_product_actuals.
actual_thickness.how_to_get: Actual thickness = (insulation OD - insulation ID) / 2. Because C585 IDs could not be verified, it is not computed here.

iron_pipe_insulation_od.description: C585 single-layer insulation OD by NPS and nominal thickness, from Sproule's reproduction (D6). Each value is cross-checked against the OC Fiberglas sizing manual (D3).
iron_pipe_insulation_od.nominal_thickness_range_in: 1 to 5 (Sproule also prints 5-1/2 to 8 in.; those columns are beyond the C585-22 scope of 1/2 to 5 in. and are omitted)
iron_pipe_insulation_od.corroboration: OC's 2022 sizing manual (D3) lists an OD for 146 of these cells and matches Sproule within 0.01 in. on 146. OC rounds fractions to 2 decimals (for example 5 9/16 to 5.56); for NPS 2 x 3 in. it prints 8.63 where it prints 8.62 elsewhere for 8 5/8.
iron_pipe_insulation_od.edition_caveat: Sproule's PDF dates from 2001 (C585-90 era). OC's 2022 manual gives the same ODs, but no C585-22 copy was available to confirm the values are unchanged.

rows.pipe_od_note: NPS 4-1/2 is not an ASME B36.10M size; insulation tables include it for nesting. OD 5.000 in per D3/D4.
NPS 7 is not in the ASME B36.10M size list used here; insulation tables include it for nesting. OD per D3/D4.

copper_tube_insulation_od.description: C585 single-layer insulation OD for copper tube, from two C585-labeled reproductions: Sproule (D6, by nominal tube size) and Extol (D7, by CTS OD). Rows are nominal 1/2 to 4 in.
discrepancies: Copper 1 nominal (1.125 OD) x 1.0 in.: Sproule 2 7/8 (2.875) vs Extol 3.0
Copper 3-1/2 nominal (3.625 OD) x 1.0 in.: Sproule 5 5/8 (5.625) vs Extol 5.56
discrepancy_context: 1 in. nominal x 1 in.: OC's sizing manual (D3) prints 2.88, and the JM (D8) and Knauf (D4) product ODs (2.83 and 2.82) sit about 0.05 in. under 2.875, matching Sproule's 2 7/8 rather than Extol's 3.00.
3-1/2 in. nominal x 1 in.: OC (D3) prints 5.56, and the JM/Knauf product ODs are 5.50/5.51, matching Extol's 5.56 rather than Sproule's 5 5/8. Sproule's 5 5/8 is probably a misprint of 5 9/16.

manufacturer_product_actuals.description: Actual as-manufactured wall thickness and OD for two fiberglass pipe insulation products (NPS 1/2 to 12). These are product data, not C585 values. Both products' ODs run about 0.05 in. under the C585 ODs above (for example 2.83/2.82 vs 2.875).

jm_micro_lok_hp.note: 'column_labeled_pipe_od_in' is printed as 'Pipe O.D.' but exceeds the true pipe OD (0.90 vs 0.840 for NPS 1/2). It equals insulation OD minus 2 x actual wall within 0.03 in. on every row, so it appears to be the insulation bore.

knauf_earthwool_1000.note: 'iron_pipe_od_in' is the steel pipe OD as printed by Knauf. Knauf states the product complies with ASTM C585; values are 'Subject to Knauf Insulation tolerances'.
flags: Knauf D4 NPS 2-1/2 x 4.5 in.: Internally inconsistent as published: OD 12.7 - 2 x wall 4.375 = 3.950 in., which is +1.075 in. larger than the 2.875 in. pipe OD. One of the two printed values is likely a typo; do not use this cell without confirming with Knauf.
